_archived.what: The last baseline recorded before `requested_action` was constrained to an enum.
_archived.why_kept: Evidence for ADR 016. Every case here scores 0.75 or below on exact-fields, and on the first live run all three lost the SAME field: requested_action. The model's answers were correct and differently worded - refund_full_amount for issue_refund, fix_checkout_api_503_errors for escalate_to_engineering, clarify_cancellation_terms for explain_cancellation_terms. A categorical field had been specified as free text, so exact match was grading the case design rather than the model.
_archived.subject: support-extraction@1 - claude-sonnet-5, JSON in prose, requested_action free text
_archived.not_a_live_baseline: This file is an archive and is deliberately not schema-valid as a baseline: it carries this key, which the strict loader rejects. Nothing compares against it.
